name: scitex_cards_app
label: Card
subtitle: Dependency-graph view of the scitex-cards task store
about: Browse and work the scitex-cards task board. View the dependency graph, comment on cards, send DMs and reactions, and attach files.
description: scitex-cards board is a browser view of the canonical task store. It renders the task dependency DAG with React Flow: nodes colored by status (goal, pending, in_progress, blocked, done, deferred, failed), depends_on arrows, and blocks inhibition edges. It also writes: card comments, DM send and reactions, and file uploads.
author: ywatanabe
capabilities: Render the task dependency graph (DAG) in the browser
Comment on cards, send DMs and reactions, upload attachments
